newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai agency affirms Bangkok Bank rating.
newsitem.headline: Thai agency affirms Bangkok Bank rating.

text.p: The Thai Rating and Information Services (TRIS) said on Wednesday it has affirmed Bangkok Bank Plc's AAA rating because of the bank's market leadership and strong competitive position.
TRIS said Bangkok Bank, Thailand's largest bank, has a sound financial performance from its diverse businesses as well as good asset quality with high loan loss reserves, and a strong capital base.

"The bank's quality growth, continuing business development and operational efficiency improvement also helps sustain its risk profile under Thailand's increasingly competitive and liberalised financial system and less supportive economic condition," TRIS said in a statement.
TRIS said Bangkok Bank has assets of over 1.1 trillion baht ($42.3 billion). Growing competition over the past years has softened its market share of Thai commercial banking assets to 23 percent.
"Continued profitability should be expected, though under some pressure of intensified competition and current economic challenges," the ratings agency said.
